title: Ball Academy
subtitle: A 3D atlas of the scrotum, testis and spermatic cord.
heading: Comparative anatomy atlas
canvasLabel: Interactive anatomy model. Drag or use the arrow keys to rotate. Click a structure to inspect it.
gesture: Drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom
touchGesture: Drag to rotate · Pinch to zoom
unavailable: This viewer requires WebGL 2. Enable hardware acceleration or try a WebGL-compatible browser.
humanNote: The human model uses mean ultrasound measurements from 248 healthy fertile men. Reference dimensions (length × width × depth) are 45.7 × 29.6 × 25.1 mm on the right and 44.7 × 28.8 × 24.4 mm on the left.
dogNote: The dog model uses mean ultrasound measurements from eight adult dogs weighing 12.4–17.2 kg. Reference dimensions (length × width × depth) are 30.7 × 22.3 × 17.0 mm on the right and 30.3 × 23.1 × 16.4 mm on the left. The tilt is illustrative.
review: Each model is scaled independently on screen. Vessels, muscle paths and internal structures are schematic. Specialist review is pending.
